theater: 阿爾及利亞南部齊巴拉沙漠

battle.name: 法赫赫之戰
battle.theater: 阿爾及利亞南部齊巴拉沙漠
battle.brief: 七八六年，阿拔斯王朝伊弗里基亞總督穆罕默德·伊本·耶齊德·朱祖利率大軍南下，討伐伊巴德派魯斯達米德國在齊巴拉沙漠的游牧根據地，卻在缺水缺糧的沙海中遭游騎夜襲與斷水，兵潰於沙。卡面這件亞述長弓是複合短弓的祖型，其形制經波斯、帕提亞、薩珊一路西傳，正是兩軍射手手中那把短弓。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 交戰的兩方是阿拔斯王朝與魯斯達米德國。阿拔斯一方由哈里發在巴格達任命、坐鎮伊弗里基亞首府凱魯安的總督穆罕默德·伊本·耶齊德·朱祖利節制，軍隊以伊弗里基亞省的常備軍為骨幹，包含早年歸附的阿拉伯部落軍與本地柏柏爾雇兵，並可抽調中央近衛與依附於省府的雜項兵力。依阿拉伯史料的常例，這種省級遠征的經費出自省稅與綠洲稅收，糧秣靠雙峰駱駝隊輸送，從凱魯安到齊巴拉綠洲帶的補給線長達數百公里，中途只在少數有井的綠洲換水餵飼。魯斯達米德一方是建國於塔赫特（提亞雷特）的伊巴德派政權，奉哈瓦利吉派教義，伊瑪目兼掌宗教與軍事大權，軍隊以伊巴德派老兵與城鄉民兵為核心，輔以游牧於齊巴拉與奧里斯山脈之間的柏柏爾輕騎和游擊步兵；這些部眾同時是商隊護衛與稅吏，慣於在沙海中晝夜轉移，並熟悉每一處井泉的所在。兩國較量的本質，是阿拔斯王朝要把伊弗里基亞南境與跨撒哈拉商道收進哈里發的財政與宗派秩序，而魯斯達米德國要在同一片沙漠維持獨立，抽取商旅過境稅，並保住伊巴德派在北非的立足點。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Abbasid Caliphate and the Rustamid state. On the Abbasid side the host was commanded by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Jazuli, the governor of Ifriqiya whom the caliph in Baghdad had appointed and who sat in the provincial capital of Kairouan; the army rested on the standing forces of Ifriqiya, including Arab tribal contingents that had submitted in the early decades of the dynasty and locally recruited Berber auxiliaries, and it could draw on the central guard and on irregular auxiliaries attached to the provincial administration. As was normal in the Arab chronicles for a provincial expedition of this kind, the cost was met out of the provincial tribute and the revenues of the oasis towns, while grain and fodder travelled on trains of two-humped camels; the supply line ran for several hundred kilometres from Kairouan to the oasis belt of the Zibala, and the animals could be watered and fed only at the few oases that possessed wells. The Rustamid side was the Ibadi polity founded at Tahert, modern Tiaret, holding to the Kharijite doctrine, with the imam holding religious and military authority in the same person; its army consisted of Ibadi veterans and town militias at the core, supported by Berber light horse and skirmishing infantry ranging between the Zibala and the Aures mountains. Those same people served as caravan guards and tax collectors, were used to moving day and night across the sand seas, and knew the position of every well. The substance of the contest was that the Abbasid dynasty wanted to bring the southern frontier of Ifriqiya and the trans-Saharan trade routes under the fiscal and sectarian order of the caliph, while the Rustamid state needed to hold the same desert as an independent power, drawing tolls from merchants crossing it and preserving an Ibadi foothold in North Africa.
people: 阿拔斯軍的統帥是穆罕默德·伊本·耶齊德·朱祖利，他以伊弗里基亞總督之職兼掌本省軍政，奉命率軍南下，此役之後仍留任一段時間，最終因敗績與軍紀問題被朝廷追究。魯斯達米德方面的主導者是伊巴德派伊瑪目阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜，現存記述多把法赫赫之役的策劃與臨場指揮記在他名下；不過魯斯達米德伊瑪目繼承的年代在現代研究之間仍有爭議，部分較早的編年因此把這一役歸給前任伊瑪目。整場戰役真正的推手是哈里發曼蘇爾與其繼承者：遠征最早在曼蘇爾在位時籌劃，跨越曼蘇爾（754至775年）、哈迪（775至786年）與拉欣·拉希德（786至809年）三朝的交接，戰役在拉欣·拉希德即位後爆發，他隨即接手，把這場戰爭寫進自己的日程。最重要的記錄者是十四世紀的伊本·赫勒敦，他在《導論》之中保存了這一役的細節，用它說明沙漠戰的補給規律與遊牧戰士的耐苦；九世紀的史家艾布·賈法爾·巴拉祖里在《征服諸國記》之中提供了更早的骨架。地方上，齊巴拉一帶的柏柏爾部眾提供嚮導、井泉情報與承擔襲擊的地面兵力；部分編年把阿里王族在敗後西遷摩洛哥、並於七八八年建立伊德里斯王朝一事，與這一役的失利連繫起來。
peopleEn: The commander of the Abbasid host was Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Jazuli, who as governor of Ifriqiya combined civil and military authority over the province and had been ordered to march south; he remained in office for a while after the defeat and was eventually called to account by the court for the reverse and for the state of discipline in his troops. On the Rustamid side the leading figure was the Ibadi imam Abd al-Wahhab, and the surviving narratives for the most part credit him with planning the campaign and directing the field action at Fakhkh; the chronology of the Rustamid imamate succession, however, remains disputed in modern scholarship, and some of the earlier chronicles therefore assign the battle to the preceding imam. The real driving force behind the whole affair was the caliph al-Mansur and his successors: the expedition was first planned during the reign of al-Mansur and straddled the handover between al-Mansur (754 to 775), al-Hadi (775 to 786) and Harun al-Rashid (786 to 809); the battle broke out after Harun had taken the throne, and he immediately took the war over and wrote it into his own agenda. The most important witness is the fourteenth-century Ibn Khaldun, who preserved the details of the engagement in the Muqaddimah and used them to illustrate the logistics of desert warfare and the hardihood of nomadic fighters; the ninth-century historian Abu Jafar al-Baladhuri supplied an older framework in the Futuh al-Buldan. On the ground, the Berber communities of the Zibala provided guides, intelligence about wells and the manpower that carried out the attack; some chronicles also connect the collapse of the Alid interest in North Africa, and the westward flight of the family that founded the Idrisid dynasty in Morocco in 788, with the reverse at Fakhkh.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓是這一役最貼切的技術線索，但必須說清楚，它並不是七八世紀北非射手手中那一把弓的同一件貨。亞述長弓是短型複合弓：以木為芯，外覆角與筋，弓體短而有力，屬於亞述王國九至七世紀前線的標準配備；亞述人靠弓與鐵的組合征服兩河流域，弓手常在車上發射，車兵則依賴弓手開路，其弓陣在多捲戰記與宮殿浮雕上都有具體描寫。此後這條技術譜系一路西傳：亞述弓形經阿契美尼德波斯與帕提亞、薩珊的弓筒形制改造，成為伊朗高原的薩珊弓，再由中亞與阿拉伯的商路進入伊斯蘭世界，變成八世紀以來阿拉伯軍隊的標準短型複合反曲弓。齊巴拉沙漠裡的兩軍射手用的正是這一支後裔：魯斯達米德方的柏柏爾游騎以它進行遠距離騷擾並掩護撤退，阿拔斯弓兵則以分批齊射的紀律成排放箭，覆蓋敵陣與退路。除了弓，戰場上常見的裝備還包括長矛與標槍、彎刀、圓盾與皮甲、馬匹與雙峰駱駝；阿拔斯軍靠雙峰駱駝攜帶帳幕、箭箱與水糧，魯斯達米德一方則更多依賴柏柏爾式的輕裝與隨身水囊。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is the most relevant technical thread for this battle, but it has to be said plainly that it is not the very same weapon as the bow in the hands of North African archers of the eighth century. The Assyrian bow was a short composite bow: a wooden core faced with horn and sinew, short in the hand but powerful in the draw, the standard piece of equipment of the Assyrian armies on their northern fronts from the ninth to the seventh century. The Assyrians conquered the river valleys with the combination of bow and iron, their archers shooting from the chariot while the chariotry relied on the archers to open the way, and that bow line appears in concrete detail in several of the annals and in the palace reliefs. The lineage then travelled west: the Assyrian profile was reshaped in the gorytos forms of Achaemenid, Parthian and Sasanian Persia into the Sasanian bow of the Iranian plateau, and from there, by the trade routes of Central Asia and Arabia, entered the Islamic world and became the standard short composite recurve bow of Arab armies from the eighth century onward. The bows in the two armies in the Zibala were precisely this descendant: the Rustamid Berber light horse used it for long-range harassment and to cover withdrawals, while the Abbasid archers fired in disciplined volleys, arrow by arrow in turn, blanketing the enemy line and the ground over which the enemy would retreat. Besides the bow, the usual equipment on the field included lances and javelins, sabres, round shields and leather armour, horses, and two-humped camels; the Abbasid army carried tents, arrow cases and water and grain on the camels, while the Rustamids relied far more on Berber-style light kit and on the water skins carried by every man.
tactics: 阿拔斯軍的打法是典型的哈里發式野戰：以密集重騎與大量投射兵為核心，弓手分批輪射，騎兵在箭雨掩護下反覆衝擊，再由步兵與弓手封鎖戰場，軍隊把以駱駝隊為核心的後勤車隊拖在最後，節制嚴謹而龐大。但這套制度在沙漠裡遇上致命弱點：隊列一旦拉長到數十公里，糧水便要靠腳力與駱駝一站一站地接力，一旦游騎切斷井泉與草場，整支大軍就失去繼續前進的能力。魯斯達米德方採取完全相反的原則：主力避開正面會戰，始終在沙丘與鹽沼之間拉開距離，只用游騎在阿拔斯軍的側翼與後方不斷襲擾，專打掉隊的後衛、落單的斥候與缺水掉隊的散兵；等阿拔斯軍被引到井泉稀少的地段、把隊形拉成細長的一條線，魯斯達米德人才在夜裡或黎明發動襲擊，同時切斷水源，封住退路，並用熟悉地形的嚮導引導部隊直插敵陣中央。得勝之後他們沒有屠殺俘虜，而是供給飲水、勸降收編，此舉既削弱了阿拔斯的聲望，又為往後的戰爭補充了受過訓練的兵員與馬匹。
tacticsEn: The Abbasid way of fighting was the classic caliphal style of field combat: a solid mass of heavy cavalry supported by large numbers of missile troops, archers firing in successive volleys, cavalry charging again and again under cover of the arrows, infantry and archers then sealing the field, with the baggage train, built around the camel caravans, brought up at the rear; the whole thing was disciplined and enormous. Against that system the desert offered a fatal weakness: once the column stretched out over tens of kilometres, water and grain had to be relayed station by station on foot and on camel, and the moment the raiders cut the wells and the grazing, the entire army lost the ability to continue forward. The Rustamids followed exactly the opposite principle: the main body avoided pitched battle and always kept its distance among the dunes and salt flats, sending light horse only to harass the flanks and the rear of the Abbasid column, going after stragglers from the rearguard, isolated scouts and men who had fallen out of line for want of water; only when the Abbasid army had been drawn into a stretch where wells were scarce and its formation drawn out into a thin line did the Rustamids strike, at night or at first light, while cutting off the water, sealing the retreat, and using guides who knew the ground to lead the attack straight into the centre of the enemy formation. After the victory they did not kill the prisoners: they gave them water, pressed them to desert, and took them into their ranks, which at one stroke ruined the reputation of the Abbasids and supplied the coming wars with trained men and horses.
data: 關於這一戰，史料留下的數字互相矛盾，只能取其大概。年份一般定於公元七八六年，即回曆一六五年前後；具體月份在阿拉伯編年中並無記載，考慮北非的作戰季節，一般多置於夏季，本檔案所填的六月即屬此類推斷。距離方面，從伊弗里基亞首府凱魯安到戰場的商道約九百公里，最後兩三百公里是無水的鹽沼、鵝卵石荒漠與連綿沙丘，沿途只有齊巴拉綠洲帶的少數井泉可供飲用。兵力方面，阿拉伯史料沒有給出可信的單一數字，後世引用者從數萬到十萬以上都有；較可靠的說法是穆罕默德·伊本·耶齊德集結了本省能調動的全部騎兵與投射兵，遠多於對手，而魯斯達米德方投入的是數千量級的伊巴德派老兵與柏柏爾游騎。損失的規模可以從後果反推：阿拔斯軍的絕大多數建制在那一季耗盡或散失，其中相當一部分死在缺水的沙海裡，其餘被俘；伊本·赫勒敦記載說，許多阿拔斯士兵在受了寬待之後轉投魯斯達米德一方，這批人攜帶了馬匹與武器，使對方的騎兵質量在數年之內反而上升。財政上也有旁證：伊弗里基亞一省依當時的約定向哈里發上繳的年貢以數十萬第納爾計，這筆收入正是這場遠征能夠組織起來的物質基礎。戰場的具體位置也只能定位到齊巴拉綠洲帶一帶，舊說多指比斯克拉以南的錫迪奧克巴綠洲，誤差在數十公里之內。
dataEn: The figures for this battle contradict one another in the sources and can only be taken in rough outline. The year is generally given as 786 CE, that is around 165 AH; no Arabic chronicle records the month, and since the campaigning season in North Africa falls in the summer, it is usually placed there, the month of June in this file being a deduction of that kind. As for distance, the caravan road from Kairouan, the capital of Ifriqiya, to the battlefield runs to about nine hundred kilometres, the last two or three hundred of them being waterless salt flats, stony desert and rolling dunes where only the few wells of the Zibala oasis belt can be drunk from. On numbers of troops the Arab sources give no single figure that can be trusted, and later writers quote anything from several tens of thousands to well over a hundred thousand; the sounder statement is that Muhammad ibn Yazid mustered all the cavalry and missile troops the province could reach, far more than his opponent, while the Rustamids committed a force of the order of a few thousand, Ibadi veterans and Berber light horse. The scale of the losses can be read back from the consequences: almost the whole of the Abbasid order of battle was spent or scattered in that campaigning season, a considerable part of it perishing in the thirsty sand seas and the rest taken prisoner; Ibn Khaldun records that a great many Abbasid soldiers, treated well, went over to the Rustamids, and since they brought horses and weapons with them, the quality of the opposing cavalry rose over the following years. There is financial corroboration as well: the tribute that Ifriqiya was assessed to pay the caliph ran to tens of thousands of dinars a year, and that income was the material basis on which the expedition was organised. The exact site of the battle can only be placed within the Zibala oasis belt, the older identifications usually pointing to the Sidi Okba oasis south of Biskra, with an error of tens of kilometres.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最遠的一層是宗派：魯斯達米德國由一批波斯伊巴德派教徒在阿拔斯王朝迫害下遷徙到馬格里布之後建立，公元七七六年立國於塔赫特，以哈瓦利吉派的教法與選舉伊瑪目的制度自成一國，正統性上完全不承認哈里發的世襲統治，這在阿拔斯人眼中是帝國腹心深處的一個異端政權。第二層是地理與財政：伊弗里基亞省從南方綠洲與跨撒哈拉商道抽取關稅，是阿拔斯王朝西境最重要的財源之一；齊巴拉的遊牧柏柏爾人長期不滿阿拔斯的稅吏與阿拉伯官吏的徵收方式，魯斯達米德人則以保護者與稅務分包者的身分介入，替他們提供較為公平的收成分成，於是游牧部眾自然倒向塔赫特。第三層是直接的導火線：阿拔斯王朝在平定伊拉克與伊朗一帶的哈瓦利吉派叛亂之後，把注意力轉到西線，哈里發曼蘇爾下令把齊巴拉綠洲與其商道收回省的直接管轄，並派穆罕默德·伊本·耶齊德率大軍南下。對魯斯達米德國而言，這是一次無法退讓的進攻：一旦游牧部眾被重新編入省稅體系，魯斯達米德的軍力、稅源與存在理由都會一併消失。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause behind the fighting. The deepest is sectarian. The Rustamid state was founded by a group of Persian Ibadi believers who migrated to the Maghrib after being persecuted under the Abbasids; it was established at Tahert in 776 and organised itself on Kharijite law and on the elective imamate, acknowledging no hereditary caliphal sovereignty at all, which made it, in Abbasid eyes, a heretical polity lodged deep inside the belly of the empire. The second layer is geographical and fiscal. Ifriqiya levied customs on the southern oases and on the trans-Saharan trade routes, and was one of the most important sources of revenue for the Abbasid western frontier; the nomadic Berbers of the Zibala had long resented the tax collectors and Arab officials sent against them, and the Rustamids moved in as protectors and tax-farming partners, offering them a fairer share, so that the nomads naturally leaned toward Tahert. The third layer is the immediate trigger. After the Abbasids had put down the Kharijite rebellions in Iraq and Iran, their attention turned west; the caliph al-Mansur ordered that the oases of the Zibala and the trade routes running through them be brought back under the direct control of the province, and sent Muhammad ibn Yazid south with a great army. For the Rustamid state this was an attack that could not be parried: once the nomads were folded back into the provincial fiscal order, the Rustamids would lose their troops, their tax base and the justification for their existence in a single stroke.
impact: 這一役的影響，首先在軍事思想上是教科書式的案例。伊本·赫勒敦在《導論》之中把它列為正規大軍敗於沙漠游騎的典型，用來說明沒有水源的沙海中補給線有多脆弱，也用來說明柏柏爾遊牧戰士的體能與耐苦如何勝過安居綠洲的阿拉伯步兵。西方與伊斯蘭世界的後世兵書也多次引述這個戰例，作為地形、補給與襲擊優先於正面會戰的證據。其次在政治上，魯斯達米德國從此獲得了一個獨立的正統性敘事：哈里發的大軍在沙漠裡崩潰，成為伊巴德派在北非以及遠在也門與波斯灣的信眾心中維持抵抗意志的樣本；戰敗之後有相當數量的阿拔斯軍官與士兵轉投對方，使魯斯達米德的騎兵在數年之內獲得一批受過會戰訓練的兵源。第三，阿拔斯王朝同時在西亞與北非開戰的戰略負擔被加重，哈里發拉欣·拉希德把大量精力放在南方，反而讓歐洲的丕平與拜占庭的處境更為寬鬆。最後是王朝內部的裂痕：此役之後阿里王族在北非的勢力崩潰，其成員西遷摩洛哥，於七八八年建立伊德里斯王朝，成為阿拔斯以外最持久的分支。魯斯達米德國本身則一直存續到九〇九年才被法蒂瑪王朝攻滅。
impactEn: The first effect of this battle is doctrinal in military terms, where it has become a textbook case. Ibn Khaldun lists it in the Muqaddimah as a type of regular army beaten by desert light horse, using it to show how fragile a supply line is in a sand sea without water, and how the endurance and hardihood of Berber nomads can outweigh Arab infantry settled in comfortable oases. Later military writing in both the Islamic and the European worlds cites the case again and again as evidence that terrain, supply and the surprise attack count for more than the pitched battle. Politically, the Rustamid state acquired a narrative of independent legitimacy: the fact that a caliphal army collapsed in the desert became, for the Ibadis of North Africa and for their coreligionists far away in Yemen and the Gulf, a model for keeping the resistance alive. After the defeat a considerable number of Abbasid officers and soldiers went over to the other side, and for several years the Rustamid cavalry could draw on a supply of men trained in set-piece battle. Third, the strategic burden on the Abbasids of fighting in the west and in the south at the same time was increased: the caliph Harun al-Rashid spent much of his energy on the south, which in turn left the European Pepin and Byzantium in a more comfortable position. Last came a rupture inside the dynasty: after this battle the Alid interest in North Africa collapsed, its members moved west to Morocco, and in 788 founded the Idrisid dynasty, the most durable branch outside the Abbasid line. The Rustamid state itself endured until 909, when it was conquered by the Fatimids.
result: 法赫赫一戰，阿拔斯軍全軍覆沒。穆罕默德·伊本·耶齊德帶著少數親信逃回伊弗里基亞，長征軍在沙漠裡耗盡了糧水與士氣，絕大部分建制散失，飢渴而死者與被俘者佔了大半，魯斯達米德人則從營地之中取得馬匹、兵器與大批戰利品，俘獲的士兵多被寬待並收編。戰局對魯斯達米德國而言是明確的勝利：齊巴拉的綠洲與井泉仍在魯斯達米德盟友的手中，阿拔斯的勢力退回奧里斯山脈與霍德納盆地一線，魯斯達米德的游騎開始越過邊界襲擾伊弗里基亞的南部農莊與商隊，切斷該省的南境收入。此後戰爭並未結束，哈里發拉欣·拉希德接手之後連續再派大軍進剿，數年之間把游牧部眾逐步逐回塔赫特與沿海的高原地帶，魯斯達米德國從一個橫跨沙漠的強國退守成以塔赫特為核心的城邦式政權，但它的獨立一直維持到九〇九年法蒂瑪王朝的攻陷。從軍事史的角度看，這場戰爭留下兩個互相印證的教訓：其一，龐大的正則軍在沒有水源的荒漠裡脆弱得不堪一擊；其二，寬待俘虜並收編敵軍，是把一次戰術勝利轉化為長期戰爭資源的辦法。
resultEn: At Fakhkh the Abbasid army was destroyed. Muhammad ibn Yazid made it back to Ifriqiya with a handful of his closest men; the expeditionary host spent its water and its morale in the desert, nearly the whole of its order of battle scattered, the larger part of the men perishing of hunger and thirst or falling into capture, while the Rustamids took horses, weapons and much booty out of the abandoned camp, and most of the prisoners were treated and taken into their ranks. The outcome was an unambiguous victory for the Rustamid state: the oases and wells of the Zibala stayed in the hands of its allies, the Abbasid push was driven back to the line of the Aures mountains and the Hodna basin, and Rustamid light horse began to cross the frontier to harry the southern farms and caravans of Ifriqiya, cutting the southern revenues of the province. The war did not end there. Once Harun al-Rashid had taken over, he sent fresh armies again and again, and over several years the nomads were driven back step by step toward Tahert and the coastal highlands, so that the Rustamid state shrank from a power spanning the desert into a city-state centred on Tahert; its independence nevertheless lasted until 909, when the Fatimids stormed it. From the point of view of military history the campaign leaves two mutually confirming lessons: first, that an enormous regular army is helplessly fragile in a desert without water; and second, that treating prisoners well and taking the enemy into one's own ranks is the way to turn a tactical victory into the resources of a long war.
